coastal.title: Heavy rain, strong winds forecast for coastal B.C., including Metro Vancouver
coastal.description: A storm system travelling southeast is forecast to bring heavy downpours and strong winds to parts of B.C. overnight Monday and into Tuesday.

kamloops.title: 'It's a disgrace': Naramata residents demand answers after termination of fire chief
kamloops.description: Naramata, B.C., residents have launched a petition calling on the Regional District of Okanagan-Similkameen to change the culture and improve the dynamics with local fire services, following the abrupt firing of fire chief Dennis Smith in July.

kamloops.title: Ottawa announces $22.4M to expand Kelowna International Airport
kamloops.description: The funding will extend basic infrastructure to more than 66.77 hectares (165 acres) of empty land, and create a runway-accessible industrial park along the airport's eastern border.

kamloops.title: Crows are being given naloxone after suspected drug overdoses in Prince George
kamloops.description: The increased toxicity of the illicit drug supply has prompted public warnings in the north-central B.C. city.

prince-george.title: Where do B.C.'s provincial political parties stand on SOGI in schools?
prince-george.description: As another provincial election gears up in B.C., sexual orientation and gender identity (SOGI) in schools is back in the political spotlight.

all.title: Alcohol is Canada’s biggest drug problem. So why aren’t people getting help?
all.description: Research shows alcohol causes more harm overall than any other drug in Canada. Some doctors and other advocates say people struggling with alcohol aren’t getting treatment options that are backed by science.
